author: LinkCraft21
quote:
This game is more than just a remake.
It is not just an ode to the anniversary of the most celebrated franchise ever but an ode to the fans of this masterpiece. People often call ocarina of time timeless and for good reason but what is truly timeless is the way this game made people feel. It captured everyone as kids and adults and brought them to a new world one which was full of fantasy and laughter. Now 28 years later we come back to this game older and wiser. A game which speaks on leaving your childhood behind and how we must come to face that aspect of life and not to sorrow but be joyful of the relationships we built and time we had. 28 years later this remake is not just a game it is a literal metaphor for its own story we as children played this game now we comeback and relive our childhood one last time now reckoning with what the present now holds.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: LinkCraft21
quote: GTA 6 is a game that is objectively technically brilliant. The immersive nature of the game is something to behold however the scummy corporation practices and the overwhelming miss of the game being 30 fps and having constant bugs completely undermines that. Furthermore the game could be saved with a genuine great story like rockstar delivered in RDR2 however this story falls flat. Arthur morgan felt so good because he felt so real. He seemed like a man constantly regretting his actions. In contrast GTA 6 story is trying to be a relationship story off 2 characters struggling to deal with their past lives and constant problems of the American system. The problem with this is the fact it’s a relationship narrative built off 2 boring characters. Jason feels like a rock and Lucia feels like an overbearing girlfriend who constantly never has to deal with consequences for her actions. Overall the story falls flat and the games only redeeming quality doesn’t do it for me unfortunately.
